headline: Fort Hays State's defence carries them five points clear
dek: Fort Hays State have won all four of their conference matches, the latest by a single goal at Ouachita Baptist on Saturday, and have conceded just once in conference play. Southern Nazarene, five points behind with a match in hand, are the only other side yet to lose a conference match.

wire.line: Harding have lost all nine of their matches this season, conceding 27 goals along the way.

findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's home match against UT Dallas is past its date with no result published, the only such match in the conference.

last_match.line: Ouachita Baptist's win on the road lifts them level on points with Newman; Northeastern State have yet to win a conference match at home.

next_match.line: The conference's only two unbeaten sides meet; Fort Hays State have yet to drop a point in conference play, while Southern Nazarene drew their last.
